title: Frozen ledger builder crashes (fail-closed) on a fractional drug quantity; one 0.5 dispense blocks the whole cohort build
what_went_wrong: build_dr_charge_ledger_p2.py does int(q) on SUM(jml); jml=0.5 raises ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '0.5'.
The P14 task doc predicted truncation to 0 (E6); the prediction was wrong.
root_cause: The builder assumes integer quantities; Khanza stores detail_pemberian_obat.jml as double and the DR cohort never had a fractional value, so no test reached it.
impact: Availability: the P6-3 rollback leaves the ledger unchanged, so nothing partial survives, but any fractional dispense in a cohort makes the ledger unbuildable. No effect on the 86,455-visit DR cohort (all integer).

correction.applied: None to the frozen builder. P14 loaded the two fractional visits after the ledger build and reported the whole visit as the delta (R5 s26.3).
correction.result: Open: P15 candidate, owner decision on the rule (round, reject per visit, or carry decimals).

rule: Pre-register a code-derived prediction only after running the code path once on a throwaway input; edge-strata fixtures must include every column type's edge (double, null, zero).
